reason: Our architect and in-house drafting already produce the renders and it's baked into the design fee, so I'd be paying twice for something we already have. I'm not going to add a vendor for a library of plans we already sell off.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? If it shows a finish, window or layout we won't build, I own that conversation with the buyer, and a one-day turnaround from PDFs makes me think nobody is checking it.
would_change_my_mind: If the free lunch build of one of my current plans matched the drawings exactly and my architect couldn't match the price or speed, I'd consider it for a few plans, not the whole library.
